case_name: Smt. Swathi Nitin Tulasalkar vs Sri. Nitin Tulasalkar
facts_of_case: Petitioner is the wife of respondent, seeking to transfer M.C.No.294/2023 from Principal Judge, Family Court, Hubballi to Principal Civil Judge and JMFC, Sagara.

legal_principles.principle: A petition for transfer of a pending proceeding can be allowed if the petitioner has a prima facie case.
legal_principles.held: Heard Sri. Rajendra.S., learned counsel for the petitioner and Mahaveer K.Jain, learned counsel for the respondent. Perused the petition papers.

legal_principles.principle: A court may transfer a pending proceeding to another court if it is in the interest of justice.
legal_principles.held: This Court made the following: ORDER 1. The petitioner, wife of the respondent is before this Court under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (for short hereinafter referred to as 'CPC'), with a prayer to transfer M.C.No.294/2023 pending on the file of Principal Judge, Family Court, Hubballi at Hubballi, filed by the respondent-husband under Section 13(1)(i-a) & (i-b) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 (for short, '1955 Act') to the Court of Principal Civil Judge and JMFC, Sagara, Shimoga, for disposal.

outcome.final_order: The petition was allowed, transferring the case to the Court of Principal Civil Judge and JMFC, Sagara.

use_for_drafting: responding to petition for dissolution of marriage
seeking judgment and decree in matrimonial dispute
